answer: Have each new agent post a small bond held in escrow, like a boat moored in a harbor, and release it only after randomly drawn peers have attested its work over several epochs. A sybil farmer must then lock capital for every fake through a long, cold tundra of waiting, while an honest agent barely notices the cost. Any identity caught duplicating answers forfeits its bond, so a zephyr of cheap spam accounts turns into an expensive gale.
